editorial.blurb: This no-frills carnitas specialist delivers authentic, family-style Mexican food with standout pork dishes and genuine hospitality that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the 1 lb Carnitas meal—it feeds two easily and comes with tortillas, salsas, and toppings. Ask to sample before you buy, and don't miss the Corundas (cheese tamales) on your next visit.
